skill.name: chronicle-remote-summarizer
skill.description: Guides an assistant through exporting Chronicle sessions from a remote system, summarizing them locally with Gemini, and importing the summary back.
skill.summary: Summarize Chronicle sessions across systems when the source host cannot access Gemini.
skill.author: ChandlerHardy

security_audit.summary: This Markdown skill is primarily a Chronicle remote summarization workflow, not executable source code. Most raw backtick detections are false positives, but confirmed risks remain around SSH command execution, secret configuration, hidden and temporary transcript files, stderr suppression, and remote overwrite behavior. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed SKILL.md content.

remediation.issue: Shell commands are constructed from host, path, and session inputs.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before execution, validate session IDs as numeric, and quote or structure host and path arguments safely.

remediation.issue: Gemini API key setup is shown as a shell command.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend secure secret entry or a dedicated secret store, and warn users about shell history and logs.

remediation.issue: Session exports and summaries are written to predictable /tmp paths.
remediation.suggestion: Use a private directory or mktemp with restrictive permissions, and delete intermediate files after import.

remediation.issue: The workflow can overwrite existing remote summaries.
remediation.suggestion: Add a confirmation step that displays the host and session ID before any import-summary operation.
Capture and review warnings by default, especially before importing generated summaries back to the remote host.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Shell Command Construction
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the assistant to ask for hostname and Chronicle path, then construct and run shell commands. Without validation or quoting rules, user-supplied host, path, or session IDs could alter SSH command behavior.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow explicitly asks for host and path values and then constructs commands. The file does not define validation, escaping, or confirmation requirements for those values.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Remote Summary Overwrite
semantic_findings.description: The workflow states that import-and-summarize overwrites existing summaries by design and later instructs the assistant to run commands. A wrong session ID or host could replace existing remote summaries.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The overwrite behavior is stated directly, and the assistant workflow includes running the command. The main uncertainty is whether the underlying Chronicle command prompts before overwrite.

content.value_statement: Remote Chronicle sessions can be hard to summarize when the source machine lacks Gemini access. This skill guides export, local summarization, and structured import back to the source system.
actual_capabilities: Exports Chronicle session JSON from a remote host over SSH.
Runs local Chronicle import-and-summarize workflows with Gemini.
Imports generated summaries back into the original remote session.
Provides a manual fallback workflow using intermediate files.
Reads saved Chronicle remote system configuration when available.
Documents batch processing, inspection, and troubleshooting flows.
limitations: Requires Chronicle on both systems and working SSH access.
Requires a local Gemini API key and compatible dependencies.
Uses shell pipelines that need careful review before execution.
Temporary files may contain sensitive session content if cleanup fails.

use_cases.title: Summarize from a restricted development host
use_cases.description: Move a Chronicle session from a remote machine without Gemini access to a local machine for summarization.

use_cases.title: Recover when SSH pipes fail
use_cases.description: Use the documented three-step workflow to inspect files and complete the summary transfer manually.

use_cases.title: Process multiple unfinished sessions
use_cases.description: Adapt the batch workflow to summarize several known session IDs after confirming targets and host details.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Remote Session
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize Chronicle session 7 from my FreeBSD host. Ask me for missing connection details before running commands.

prompt_templates.title: Use Saved Remote Config
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my saved Chronicle remote system configuration to summarize session 12 and import the result back to the source host.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Before Import
prompt_templates.prompt: Export and summarize remote session 18, then show me the summary for review before importing it back.

prompt_templates.title: Batch Remote Sessions
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the remote sessions I name, summarize each one locally, and confirm before overwriting any existing remote summaries.

output_examples.input: Session 7 exists on a FreeBSD host without Gemini access.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms host details, exports the session, summarizes it locally, and reports that the summary was imported back.

output_examples.input: The one-line SSH pipeline hangs during summarization.
output_examples.output: The assistant switches to the manual workflow, creates reviewable intermediate files, and imports the summary after confirmation.
The assistant confirms the target IDs, processes them one by one, and reports success or failure for each session.

best_practices: Confirm the remote host, session ID, and Chronicle path before running SSH commands.
Inspect generated summaries before importing them when session content is sensitive.
Delete temporary session and summary files after the workflow completes.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into commands that may be saved in shell history.
Do not run batch imports without confirming each target session ID.
Do not suppress errors when troubleshooting failed imports or summaries.

faq.question: What does this skill summarize?
faq.answer: It summarizes Chronicle sessions exported from another system and imports the summary back into the original session.

faq.question: Does it require SSH?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflows assume SSH access between the local machine and the remote Chronicle host.

faq.question: Does it call Gemini?
faq.answer: Yes. The local machine must have Gemini API access configured for Chronicle summarization.

faq.question: Can I review the summary first?
faq.answer: Yes. The manual workflow supports inspecting the generated summary before importing it back to the remote host.

faq.question: Can it process multiple sessions?
faq.answer: Yes, but batch workflows should confirm each session ID before importing summaries or overwriting existing ones.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive sessions?
faq.answer: Use caution. Session exports and summaries can contain sensitive data, especially when stored in temporary files.
